enhancements.name: Repository security posture scoring
enhancements.evidence: Versioned score and individual check results
enhancements.gate: Scores inform review and never authorize changes.

enhancements.name: Continuous fuzzing
enhancements.evidence: Reproducer corpus, crash signature, coverage delta
enhancements.gate: Sandbox only; no production targets or private data.

enhancements.name: Mutation testing
enhancements.gate: Time budget and language support confirmed.

enhancements.name: SBOM per release
enhancements.evidence: SPDX or CycloneDX document bound to release digest
enhancements.gate: Privacy review before publishing internal metadata.

enhancements.name: Artifact attestations
enhancements.evidence: Verified provenance linked to workflow and commit
enhancements.gate: Verification policy exists; signing alone is insufficient.

enhancements.name: SLSA maturity assessment
enhancements.gate: No certification claim without independent validation.

enhancements.name: Dependency reachability and VEX
enhancements.evidence: Component, path, runtime exposure, and exploitability rationale

enhancements.name: Chaos and recovery drills
enhancements.evidence: Hypothesis, blast radius, recovery time, rollback result

enhancements.name: Canary and error-budget policy
enhancements.evidence: Service indicators, budget, stop and promotion rules
enhancements.gate: No automatic promotion without policy approval.

enhancements.name: Detector quality benchmarking
enhancements.evidence: Precision, recall proxy, false-positive rate, runtime, cost
enhancements.gate: Test corpus excludes live malware and private production data.

enhancements.name: Playbook effectiveness and retirement
enhancements.evidence: Repair success, recurrence, regression, and cost history
enhancements.gate: Failed results retained; stale playbooks are deprecated.
